latest.verification_note: A mandi price is published only when at least 2 configured government price feeds report the same market, commodity, date and modal price. Prices reported by a single feed are shown separately as clearly labelled single-source observations and are never presented as cross-verified.

source_prices.policy: Each feed is displayed separately exactly as reported. Prices are not averaged or merged. These rows are single-source observations; only data/latest.json contains prices that passed the multi-source gate.
source_prices.policy_hi: हर feed का भाव उसके अपने नाम से अलग दिखाया गया है। भावों को मिलाया या औसत नहीं किया जाता। ये single-source भाव हैं; सत्यापित भाव data/latest.json में होते हैं।
